title: Ozarks Lyric Opera Presents: Tosca 3/21
seo_title: Tosca by Ozarks Lyric Opera at Gillioz Theatre, Mar 21
description: Ozarks Lyric Opera presents Puccini's Tosca for the first time, a tale of love, betrayal, political intrigue, and murder, conducted and directed by Kyle Wiley Pickett and Alice Wiley Pickett. Seating is reserved, and the listing notes that not all productions may be appropriate for every person or for all ages. It takes place Sunday, March 21, 2027 at 2:30 PM at the Gillioz Theatre, 325 Park Central, E Springfield, Missouri, with doors at 1:30 PM.
